questions: How long have you had the cough, and has it been getting worse?
Do you have a fever or chills, or have you had any sputum (what color) with the cough?
Are you short of breath or wheezing right now?
What is your oxygen saturation (SpO₂) on a pulse oximeter, if it has been measured?
Do you have wheezing when you breathe out?
Have you ever had wheezing before or been diagnosed with asthma?

Do you have chest pain (especially sharp pain that’s worse when you breathe in)?
